title: Air-fryer roast vegetable traybake
subtitle: Mixed vegetables roasted together in the air fryer until caramelised.
excerpt: Red pepper, courgette, and red onion tossed in oil and herbs and air-fried until the edges caramelise and the vegetables are tender throughout. Ready in 22 minutes. Serves four as a side.
sourceNotes: Roasted mixed vegetables are a British and Mediterranean side dish. The combination of pepper, courgette, and red onion is a classic ratatouille-adjacent preparation. The air fryer produces concentrated, caramelised edges faster than a conventional oven without the need to stir or watch.

recipe.batchNotes: Roast in batches if your air fryer is small. Keep warm in a low oven while the second batch cooks.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Roasted vegetables keep in the fridge for up to 3 days and are good cold.

content.text: The key to roasted vegetables in the air fryer is cutting everything to a similar size so the pieces cook at the same rate, and not crowding the basket. A mounded basket produces steamed vegetables with no caramelisation. If you have a small air fryer, cook in two batches. Cut all vegetables to roughly 3 cm pieces.

items.prepNote: deseeded and cut into 3 cm pieces
cut into 8 wedges, layers kept together

content.text: Toss the {{pepper-red}} red pepper pieces, {{courgette}} courgette rounds, and {{red-onion}} red onion wedges with {{olive-oil}} of olive oil and {{sea-salt-flakes}} of flaked salt in a large bowl. Add the {{garlic}} crushed garlic cloves if using. Preheat the air fryer to 200°C. Spread in a single layer in the basket ,  cook in two batches if necessary. Cook for 11 minutes, shake the basket, and cook for a further 10-11 minutes until the edges are caramelised and the vegetables are tender. Drizzle with {{balsamic-vinegar}} of balsamic vinegar if using.

items.cause: Too many vegetables in the basket at once.
items.fix: Cook in a single layer. If the vegetables are piled, the moisture they release stays trapped and produces steam rather than dry heat.

items.cause: Cut too thin or cooked too long.
items.fix: Cut courgette into 2 cm rounds, not slices. Check at 20 minutes ,  courgette cooks faster than pepper and onion.

items.symptom: Onion charring while other vegetables still raw
items.cause: Onion wedges cut too small or layers separated.
items.fix: Keep the onion wedges large and keep the layers together. Small separated pieces char very quickly.

content.text: Roasted vegetables from the air fryer work as a side to grilled meat or fish, stirred through pasta with a little olive oil and grated parmesan, or layered into a sandwich or wrap. They are also good cold in a grain salad or over hummus with flatbread.
